name: uat-dry4-a-toxodb
turns: Toxoplasma gondii GT1 genes with a signal peptide that have no ortholog in Neospora caninum Liverpool.

The facts list shows the excluded species as Neospora caninum Liverpool, so I think that part is fine. Just a question, don't change anything: how many of the signal-peptide genes did the ortholog filter remove?
